create_benchmark_config: create a BenchmarkConfig with custom batch size, sequence length, and attention implementation
build_benchmark_suite: build a suite of benchmark configs using get_config_by_level with different optimization levels
adapt_benchmark_configs: adapt a list of benchmark configs by varying batch size, sequence length, and iteration counts
test_benchmark_validity: test a BenchmarkConfig and verify its validity with automatic fallbacks for unsupported combinations
summarize_benchmark_config: summarize a BenchmarkConfig by converting it to a dictionary or inferred human-readable name
